author: EmuCore - Hub
title: 20 PS2 Games Test on AetherSX2 (Snapdragon 732g) Redmi Note 10 Pro
summary: tabeneru tests twenty PS2 games on the two-big-core Snapdragon 732G, explicitly relating AetherSX2’s CPU guidance to a Redmi Note 10 Pro below the recommended Snapdragon 845-class performance tier.

blocks.text: The forty-minute run documents a meaningful lower-midrange case rather than hiding the host behind gameplay. Snapdragon 732G has two large CPU cores, and the description explains why multi-threaded VU behavior and overall speed differ from recommended four-big-core designs. Twenty titles include Shadow of the Colossus, Ratchet & Clank, Gran Turismo 4, Black and several slower-paced alternatives. Equal two-minute chapters make broad scanning possible while preserving the exact Redmi Note 10 Pro platform.

An early-access December 2021 emulator, external cooling pad and individual settings constrain every result. Gameplay capture may add overhead, yet the video does not publish frame-time graphs, temperatures or a control run without recording. Two minutes can miss later levels and sustained throttling. Read the showcase as evidence about workload diversity on one under-recommended SoC, not a list of universally playable games. Reproduce difficult scenes, disclose cooling and resolution, and avoid enabling threading options solely because they help a different CPU topology.
